SELECT 
  fished_date_doy as doy, 
  cls, 
  COUNT(*) as trips,
  ROUND(AVG(CAST(yt AS FLOAT)), 2) as avg_yt,
  SUM(yt) as total_yt
FROM trips 
WHERE fished_date_season = 6 AND fished_date_doy BETWEEN 32 AND 60
GROUP BY fished_date_doy, cls
ORDER BY fished_date_doy, cls
